The news discussed in this episode includes:

  • Apple is exploring the acquisition of an AI chip startup to strengthen its infrastructure
  • OpenAI says it has seen no evidence to support Apple's allegations of trade secret theft
  • OpenAI's first device will be a portable speaker with a camera and other sensors
  • Apple has added a 36-month installment payment option for iPad purchases
  • Apple has just shut down a popular workaround method for purchasing unlocked iPhones
